title: Chapter 4: Being Brave Is The Obligation Of Every Qin Person
content:
Chapter 4: Being Brave Is The Obligation Of Every Qin Person

"Hei Fu, Hei Fu, is indeed a reckless man. He has done me a lot of harm..."

Ji Ying held a dagger in his hand and was wary of the thief in front of him, feeling very regretful. How could I, such a shrewd person in the past, act impulsively and follow Heifu to stand in front of these four thieves?

The man who was chased before was probably a local businessman. While running for his life, he did not forget the heavy package on his body. When he saw someone coming to stop the thieves, he suddenly beamed with joy, immediately got behind them, said "Thank you" and disappeared, leaving only Ji Ying and Hei Fu, two against four.

The four thieves were Yunmengze's bandits at first glance. Three of them were in ragged clothes and had dark faces. They were armed with simple weapons, either swords tied to short sticks, axes, or harpoons. Only the bearded man in the middle was wearing broken leather armor and holding a polished iron sword!

This person was the leader of the thieves. Seeing that Ji Ying and Hei Fu had ruined their good deeds, he spread his arms and told the three accomplices to disperse. At the same time, he said in a thick local accent: "If you want to survive, let them go." open!"

Heifu was not afraid. In his previous life, he often followed him on missions when he was an intern at the police station. He had seen many similar scenes, so he smiled and said, "This is what I should say to you." At the same time, he pointed at Ji Ying. Said: "One for you, three for me!"

After saying that, Heifu suddenly stepped forward, approached the bearded man, and made a stabbing gesture, forcing the thief to take a few steps back...

Things happened very fast. By the time Ji Ying reacted, Heifu had already attracted the attention of three people, and the remaining thief found him.

Although Ji Ying boasted that he was very skilled in martial arts, in fact he only learned some self-defense skills such as three punches and two kicks. Fortunately, the thieves he fought had no skills. The two were noobs pecking each other for a long time, except that they were covered in dirt and panting. , were not injured.

But Ji Ying was still heartbroken. He felt that with one against three, Heifu was definitely no match. Once the three thieves finished Heifu, they would besiege him.

This time it's bloody bad luck! Ji Ying was about to cry without tears, and cursed secretly: "I'm only nineteen, and I haven't married yet! If I die like this, how can I be worthy of my parents?"

Just when he was thinking about how to escape, he heard a muffled grunt from behind. Ji Ying was shocked. He thought it was Hei Fu who had been attacked. When he took a moment to take a look, he saw an axe-wielding thief viciously charging towards Hei Fu. He had fallen to the ground, his ankle was struck by a sword, and he was holding his stomach, his expression in pain!

"Huh? Heifu, this guy is pretty good."

Before Ji Ying could express his praise, the thief in front of him pounced on him again. The two struggled together and separated after a while. At this time, he heard another scream and turned around quickly, only to see that the thief who wielded the dagger was also knocked to the ground by Heifu. He was covering his bloody thigh with both hands and kept wailing. The dagger was deeply pierced. Only the hilt remains.

Ji Ying was a little surprised now: "Knocking down two people in a row, Hei Fu is really powerful!"

It happened so suddenly that Ji Ying had no idea what happened behind him, but what happened next was something he would never forget.

At this time, Heifu's sword was stuck in the leg of the second fallen criminal. He had no weapon in his hand, but he still had to face the heavily armed bearded man. What should he do now?

The big man with the beard also thought of this and laughed wildly, "Xiao Zhuzi, no matter how skilled you are, without weapons, you are no match for Nai Gong!"

After saying that, he roared "Death!" and rushed towards Heifu with a blade in one hand! This posture is to stab the black man through!

Ji Ying's heart was in his throat, but Hei Fu didn't panic. He stood on the spot with his legs spread apart, his feet moving slightly, his fists on his chest, and his eyes fixed on the movements of the bearded man. , determine its attack range.

When he was about to rush forward, he suddenly gave way. At the same time, his right hand quickly grabbed the thief's left arm, pulled it hard towards him, and used his left hand to turn into a fist and hit the thief's elbow!

Bang! In just one move, the dagger of the bearded man was knocked cleanly from his hand.

Not only Ji Ying, but also the big man with the beard was stunned. This was like grabbing a sword with bare hands!

The big man with the beard was frightened and kept retreating. He lost his weapon, but he was still brave and wanted to fight back with his fist.

Heifu had already expected it. He first blocked him and grabbed his arm. Then he raised his left foot and kicked the thief in the abdomen, hitting his target!

When the big man bent over in pain, Hei Fu slammed his left elbow into his back, forcing the bearded man to lie on the ground, unable to move. Then Hei Fu picked up the weapon and held it against his throat...

The whole process only took a moment. Heifu used his smooth moves to knock down the three thieves cleanly!

Ji Ying was so surprised that he opened his mouth wide. Seeing this, the thief who was confronting him had already fled...

Heifu held down the bearded man and was panting. He knew that he was in a very dangerous situation just now, and it was far from being as easy as it seemed.

Qin was a martial art country, and men always carried weapons when going out. His dagger was only over a foot long, which was the same length as the fighting dagger from the armed police academy in later generations. Fighting with the dagger held in reverse was precisely the skill Heifu practiced the most. Moreover, he was left-handed in his past and present lives, so his moves were different from those of ordinary people, making him difficult to guard against.

The two thieves who rushed up rashly had been hungry for a long time and were weak and thin. Of course, they were no match for Heifu, and they were knocked to the ground within a few seconds.

The trouble is, when Heifu's dagger stabbed into the leg of the thief holding a dagger, the bearded man was also attacking him, forcing Heifu to abandon the sword and retreat, and a wound was opened on his elbow.

Fortunately, he still has a trump card, which is the "enemy catching fist" he learned at the Armed Police Academy in his previous life! After coming to this era, he would practice a few moves when there was no one around, hoping that they would come in handy today.

There are sixteen styles of Capturing the Enemy Boxing, using both hands and feet, and combining wrestling and capturing. Depending on the situation, it can be used to fight against four enemies. It is by no means comparable to the weak military style boxing.

What front-line police officers often face are not martial arts masters who have received systematic training, but hooligans or armed thugs with no brute force. Therefore, the enemy-capturing fist is perfectly suitable to be used to deal with the little thieves who turned into bandits in ancient times.

As for the magical "seize the blade with bare hands" in Ji Ying's eyes, it is just the fourth move of catching the enemy's fist, "grabbing the wrist and smashing the elbow". It is the best move to deal with criminals holding weapons, and then followed by "tripping the leg and throwing it". With one move of "kick to the side and smash down", he subdued the bearded man.

Although these thieves were desperadoes, most of the people they robbed were unarmed merchants and fishermen. Where had I seen such professional moves? In addition, with three enemies and one being a little careless, taking turns taking turns gave Heifu the opportunity to defeat each one. If they all swarmed, Hei Fu felt that he might not be able to win.

"What are you doing? Help me tie them up."

At this time, the bearded man underneath him began to struggle desperately. Heifu quickly restrained him. Seeing that Ji Ying was still in a daze, he shouted a few times. Only then did Ji Ying realize and limped over to help. Just now During the fight, he sprained his foot.

"Heifu, it turns out that your martial arts skills are so good. No wonder you are not afraid of using a small number to defeat a large number."

Ji Ying took off his belt, found Fujiko, helped Heifu tie up the three thieves tightly, and began to praise his skills.

"Then why did you stand up with me?" Ji Ying's three-legged cat kung fu was also noticed by Hei Fu, but he didn't despise it and didn't immediately turn around and run away, which was pretty good.

"I'm not afraid of being held accountable by the officials afterwards."

Ji Ying explained helplessly: "You are right, the law states that if someone robs and kills people on the road, and passers-by within a hundred steps away do not rescue them, they will be treated as the second armor!"

赀 means fine. Heifu knew this rule, and it was one of the reasons why he respected the laws of Qin. In later generations, acting bravely when facing justice was only a "virtue", but in Qin, acting bravely when facing justice was expressly protected by the law and became a "virtue". A kind of obligation, an obligation that every Qin person should fulfill!

"If future generations can do the same..."

Hei Fu sighed in his heart. It was really not that he favored the past over the present. It was just a strange phenomenon in the 21st century that old people fell to the ground and did not dare to help them. Instead, they were blackmailed when they helped them. It was really chilling. He could only say: "People's hearts are not ancient." ".

If it were placed in Qin State, if an old man fell, would you dare not try to help him? Do you dare to try blackmailing me after being helped up?

The officials of Qin State will teach you how to be a good person every minute using laws instead of morality!

"Do you know how much a second penalty is worth?" Ji Ying tied the last knot and raised his head and asked.

"This..." Heifu first came to this era, and he didn't know much about the prices of various commodities.

Before he could remember, Ji Ying said in rapid succession: "In Nanjun, the price of a first-class A is 1,344 yuan, and the second-class A is 2,688 yuan!"

"Really expensive!"

Heifu sighed. He somehow knew that the price of rice in Anlu County ranged from forty to one hundred and twenty yuan per shi depending on the years of good times and famine. Taking this year's rice price of "eighty yuan per shi" as the calculation, Erjia, equivalent to a fine of 33 shi of millet, is a year and a half ration for a seven-foot-old man like Heifu, which is not a small amount.

To talk about the characteristics of Qin's law, one word is: meticulous. Even small things like a mouse biting the granary pocket must be taken care of. One more word: heavy! From the fines, we can see the severity of Qin's laws.

This means that just by not helping the old lady who fell down, a group of soldiers who were not wealthy could suffer huge economic losses. No wonder later generations often say that Qin's laws are harsh.

But on the other hand, if there is a heavy punishment, there must be a heavy reward!

After tying up the three thieves and finding some herbal leaves to help Heifu treat the wounds on his hands, Ji Ying asked mysteriously, "Do you know how much reward the government will give you for capturing one of the thieves?"

Heifu said: "Don't try to offend me, just say it quickly."

"This is what I heard from Youyou in the countryside."

Ji Ying picked up a branch, wrote fourteen and three on the ground, then pointed at them and said: "The law says that if you can capture a group of thieves alive, it is equivalent to beheading to the second level, and the government will reward you with fourteen gold!" One tael of gold is worth 576 and a half taels..."

Before he could finish counting his fingers, Heifu finished the mental calculation, took a breath and said: "Fourteen gold, that's 8064 money... Oh my god."

"Yes, that's right. If you capture three people, you should be rewarded with more than 24,000 yuan!"

Speaking of this, Ji Ying patted Hei Fu on the shoulder with envy and said: "Hei Fu, you have made a fortune. You have never forgotten each other even if you are rich and noble!"
